request.tone: mystery and courage; peril moderate, scariness moderate, violence none
request.note: catalog book read blind; no request text exists

pitch.hero: Mira, a girl who misses the last bus and is drawn through fog to the long-dark Hollow Lighthouse
pitch.want: to find out what the ghost light is and what happened to keeper Ferris, who vanished a year ago
pitch.obstacle: fog, rotten rails and ladders, rising tide, stuck locks, and the temptation to force or take things
pitch.stake: a careless or forced move ends the night safe but with the mystery unsolved
pitch.ending_kind: branch and bottleneck: many solved-mystery wins, quiet neutral exits, and safe setbacks

mira.name: Mira
mira.want: to solve the mystery of the Hollow Lighthouse and set it right
mira.voice: third person past; curious, careful, weighs patience against nerve; honest under temptation

ferris.name: Ferris
ferris.role: the vanished lighthouse keeper; offstage until one ending
ferris.want: to be found, forgiven and to have the tower lit true again
ferris.voice: speaks through his log, journal, notes and letter; cramped, hurried hand

smuggler.name: the smuggler
smuggler.role: antagonist, never seen; signs the ledger with an initial
smuggler.want: the tower as a secret store and the keeper's silence

stranger.name: the stranger in the photograph
stranger.role: unnamed man beside Ferris on the gallery (a_hearth_ash)

truth.question: What happened to keeper Ferris, and what is the ghost light in the Hollow Lighthouse?
truth.statement: Ferris did not vanish. A smuggler who had paid him for years to look the other way came to want the tower itself, threatened him and drove him out, so Ferris fled inland to a shepherd's cottage on the moor. The ghost light is a made light, a shuttered lantern with angled mirrors dressed with glowing cave-weed, which Ferris left burning so someone from town would come and find the truth; the smuggler's undeclared goods are stored in a tunnel beneath the tower.

mira_on_headland.text: Mira is out alone on the foggy headland at night, near the Hollow Lighthouse.

mira_missed_bus.text: Mira missed the last bus by four minutes.

fog_on_headland.text: A thick fog has rolled in over the headland.

hollow_lighthouse.text: The Hollow Lighthouse stands on the headland.

ferris_keeper.text: Old Ferris was the lighthouse keeper.

ferris_vanished_year.text: Ferris vanished a year ago without a word.

lighthouse_empty.text: The lighthouse has stood dark and empty since Ferris vanished; nobody has lived there or wanted to.

light_in_lamp_room.text: Tonight a pale light flickers on and off in the lamp room.

four_ways.text: Four ways lead from the tower: the keeper's cottage, the tower stair, the sea caves and the old boathouse.

tower_believed_haunted.text: Everyone believed the tower abandoned and haunted.

cottage_abandoned_tea.text: A mug of tea in the cottage has turned to dust, as if Ferris stepped out one morning and never came back.

cottage_desk_shelves_hearth.text: The cottage holds a shut roll-top desk, sagging shelves and a cold hearth.

keepers_log_last_page.text: The keeper's log lies open on the desk to a last entry that stops mid-sentence.

desk_drawer_locked.text: A small drawer under the desk is locked.

ferris_lit_no_lamp.text: Ferris wrote that a light burned in the tower on nights when he swore he had lit no lamp.

log_footsteps.text: Ferris's log tells of footsteps on the shore coming closer night after night.

hall_to_tower_door.text: A hallway from the cottage leads to the tower's inner door.

letter_opener.text: A bent, thin letter-opener lies on the desk.

brass_key_in_drawer.text: The locked drawer holds a brass key wrapped in oilcloth.

cottage_plan.text: A folded plan of the cottage halls has a line inked toward the tower door.

ships_in_bottles.text: The shelves hold ships in bottles and a row of leather logbooks, one worn shiny.

bottle_sketch_hidden_door.text: A paper hidden in a bottled ship sketches a hidden door at the foot of the tower.

logbook_note_follow_hall.text: A worn logbook holds dried sea-holly and the keeper's note: follow the hall when the light burns wrong.

hearth_loose_brick.text: One firebrick in the hearth sits crooked and loose.

ferris_photo_stranger.text: A half-burned photograph shows Ferris on the lamp gallery beside a stranger.

mira_saw_ferris_photo.text: Mira has seen a photograph of Ferris.

brick_cavity_bundle.text: Behind the loose brick a cavity holds a cloth-wrapped bundle.

hearth_key_tower_mark.text: The key from the hearth is stamped with a tower mark.

tower_mark_sketched_in_cottage.text: Mira has seen the tower mark sketched elsewhere in the cottage.

kitchen_side_corridor.text: A side corridor through the dark kitchen also leads to the tower's inner door.

kitchen_draught_gap.text: A cold draught smelling of stone and sea comes through a gap behind the pantry shelves.

tower_door_locked.text: The tower's inner door is locked.

tower_door_ajar.text: The tower's inner door stands ajar.

journal_on_hook.text: The keeper's battered journal hangs on a hook beside the tower's inner door.

mira_has_journal.text: Mira has the keeper's battered journal.

lamp_light_no_heat.text: The lamp-room light pulses with no heat and no flame she can see.

lamp_room_lens_gallery_clock.text: The lamp room holds the great glass lens, a door to the gallery walk and a clockwork weight on a chain.

glow_from_cracked_panel.text: The great lens is not lit; the glow is thrown up through a cracked panel near its base.

hidden_reflector_recent.text: A second small reflector has been fitted behind the old one, on purpose and recently.

light_rises_from_below.text: The light climbs up a shaft from far below the lamp room.

stair_beside_lens.text: A narrow stair beside the lens curls down along the light shaft.

light_is_rigged_trick.text: The tower's light is built by hand, a trick and not a ghost or magic.

gallery_rail_rusted.text: The gallery rail is furred with rust and the drop below is hidden in fog.

grille_glow_at_base.text: A thin glow leaks from a grille low at the tower's base.

clock_floor_stair.text: Winding the clockwork drops open a floor section onto a stair into the tower's core.

maintenance_stair.text: A maintenance stair runs down beside the chain shaft.

way_down_splits.text: The way down splits into a spiral stair and a cramped service hatch.

tower_foot_landing.text: Mira is on a low landing at the foot of the tower.

journal_on_stool.text: The keeper's battered journal lies open on an old stool on the landing at the tower's foot.

caves_breathe_tide.text: The sea caves breathe with the tide; three ways open off the entrance pool: a wet passage, glimmering tide pools and a carved arch.

tide_rising_in_caves.text: The tide is coming in and the water in the caves is rising.

passage_to_ledge_steps.text: The wet passage opens above the tideline onto a dry ledge with slick steps cut upward.

glowing_weed_pools.text: The tide pools glow with pale weed the same colour as the tower's strange light.

weed_paints_ghost_light.text: The glowing weed is what paints the tower's ghost light; nothing is haunted.

cave_stair_up.text: A stair leads up out of the caves toward the tower.

brass_tide_badge.text: A keeper's brass tide-badge on a broken chain lay lost in a tide pool.

arch_tally_marks.text: The arch is scratched with rows of tally marks and a shorthand warning.

tallies_unlogged_light_nights.text: The tallies count nights the tower's light burned that no keeper logged lighting.

narrow_gap.text: Beyond the arch the passage narrows to a gap barely wide enough for her shoulders.

under_tower_steps_ladder.text: Under the tower, worn steps and an iron ladder lead up.

boathouse_dinghy_locker_loft.text: The leaning boathouse holds a tarped dinghy, a tool locker and a rickety ladder to a loft.

oilskins_bailing_tin.text: Under the tarp lie folded oilskins and a bailing tin that rattles.

chart_passage_under_lighthouse.text: A coastline chart shows a passage inked under the lighthouse.

floor_hatch_boathouse.text: A floor hatch in the boathouse leads down toward the tower.

light_is_signal.text: The light is not a ghost; it is a signal.

locker_rope_lantern.text: The tool locker holds a coil of good rope and a rusted storm lantern half full of oil.

mira_has_rope.text: Mira carries a coil of rope.

loft_ladder_broken_rungs.text: The loft ladder is missing rungs and one near the top is cracked through.

loft_signal_flags_code.text: The loft holds signal flags and a diagram of lamp-flash patterns like a code.

boathouse_door_storm.text: The boathouse door bangs in a rising wind.

journal_three_threads.text: The journal holds entries about a light that burned wrong, a ledger of night cargoes and a sketch of a tunnel.

undeclared_cargoes.text: Cargoes were landed at the tower after dark and never declared.

journal_tunnel_sketch.text: The journal sketches a tunnel beneath the tower in a hurried, afraid hand.

ferris_unaware_light_source.text: Ferris could not explain what made the light; he only believed it was some mechanism.

light_made_source_below.text: Ferris wrote that the light was real but made, its source hidden below the lamp room.

journal_points_hidden_stair.text: The journal points the way to a hidden stair.

light_nights_foggy.text: Every date the light burned fell on a foggy night.

light_tied_to_cargo.text: The light burned on the same nights the secret cargoes were landed.

hidden_panel_open.text: A hidden panel in the landing wall has swung open onto the hidden stair.

hidden_stair_climbs_up.text: The hidden stair climbs upward into the tower's core.

hidden_stair_down_to_tunnel.text: The hidden stair is the only dry way down to the tunnel below; other routes flood.

ledger_initial_not_keeper.text: The cargo entries are signed with an initial that is not the keeper's.

someone_else_used_tower.text: Someone other than Ferris had been using the tower.

ledger_unbalanced.text: Goods came into the tower again and again but almost nothing left.

ledger_page_torn.text: One ledger page has been torn out.

tower_private_store.text: Someone used the empty tower as a private store for goods nobody wanted found.

torn_page_names_store.text: The torn page, found in the back cover, names a hidden store deep in the tower.

smuggler_paid_ferris.text: One smuggler paid Ferris for years to look the other way.

smuggler_wanted_tower.text: In the end the smuggler wanted the tower itself and the keeper's silence, not his cooperation.

cellar_door_locked.text: A low cellar door with a heavy lock sits in the landing's shadowed corner.

sea_gate_on_sketch.text: The sketch shows the tunnel running out under a sea gate.

marked_flagstone.text: A loose flagstone on the landing bears the cross drawn on the sketch.

stair_splits_wind_outer.text: The hidden stair splits into a tight winding stair and outer steps open to the fog.

hollow_step.text: One step near the top of the winding stair sounds hollow.

frosted_glass_door.text: The climb ends at a small, warm door of frosted glass glowing from within.

light_rig_lantern_mirrors.text: The ghost light is a shuttered lantern rigged with angled mirrors throwing a glow up the tower's shaft.

rig_dressed_with_weed.text: The light is dressed with glowing cave-weed to give it its eerie colour.

three_ways_down.text: From the light chamber three ways lead down: a stone stair, a service shaft and an outer ladder.

landing_cupboard.text: A cupboard on the stone stair holds the keeper's things: lamp parts, wire and a coat smelling of pipe smoke.

spare_lens_rig_marks.text: A spare lens in the cupboard is scored with marks that match the mirror rig.

note_gone_not_lost.text: A note in the keeper's coat reads: gone but not lost.

undercroft_tunnel_mouth.text: The way down ends in a damp undercroft opening onto a tunnel mouth.

shaft_staples_rope.text: The service shaft has iron staples for a ladder and a frayed knotted rope.

brick_tunnel_to_sea.text: A low brick tunnel runs from beneath the lighthouse out toward the sea.

lantern_lit_at_tunnel_mouth.text: Mira lit an old storm lantern she found at the tunnel mouth.

tunnel_three_branches.text: The tunnel splits toward a sealed door, a store of crates and a barred sea gate.

sketch_marks_keeper_room.text: The keeper's sketch marks the sealed door as his own private room.

crate_store_unmarked.text: A store in the tunnel is stacked high with unmarked crates.

keeper_door_oak_brass.text: The keeper's door is brass-bound oak with his mark burned into it.

old_key_in_lock.text: A stiff, rusted old key still sits in the keeper's door lock.

beam_blocks_passage.text: A heavy beam has fallen across the passage behind her.

keeper_door_opens.text: The keeper's door swings open on a small sealed room.

ledger_box_in_store.text: A small locked ledger box sits on top of the crates in the store.

crates_hold_contraband.text: The store's crates hold lamp oil and fine cloth never meant to pass any customs house: a smuggler's haul.

ledger_box_lists.text: The ledger box lists names, dates and figures of goods that never passed customs.

store_door_to_keeper_room.text: A low door at the back of the store leads on toward the keeper's room.

sea_gate_rising.text: The tide breathes through the barred sea gate and the water is climbing its bars.

keeper_room_under_sea.text: The keeper's sealed room lies under the sea, snug and dry, with a lamp, a bunk and a desk.

sealed_letter_on_desk.text: A sealed letter lies at the centre of the keeper's desk.

smuggler_drove_ferris_out.text: A smuggler threatened Ferris and drove him from his own tower.

ferris_left_light_burning.text: Ferris left the false light burning behind him.

very_late_mira_tired.text: It is very late and Mira is cold and tired.

letter_addressed_brave.text: The letter is addressed to whoever is brave enough to climb.

ferris_fled_inland.text: Ferris did not vanish: he fled the smuggler's threats and hid inland.

light_purpose_call_town.text: Ferris left the light as a quiet cry for help, so someone from town would come and find the truth.

letter_map_confession_plea.text: The letter ends with a map, a signed confession and a plea.

map_to_shepherds_cottage.text: The map leads across the inland moor to a small shepherd's cottage.

plea_sorry_light_true.text: Ferris's plea asks the reader to tell them he is sorry and to light the tower true again.

mira_keeps_letter_sealed.text: Mira keeps the letter sealed to hand to the right people in daylight.

mira_has_phone.text: Mira has a phone that takes photographs.

evidence_photographed.text: Mira photographed the crates and the ledger box as evidence.

hidden_hoard.text: Deeper in, the smuggler kept a hidden hoard for himself, apart from the store's crates.

store_crates_declared.text: The crates back in the store are declared goods.

jeweled_compass.text: A small jewelled compass rests on top of the hidden hoard.

hoard_photographed.text: Mira photographed the whole hidden hoard without touching it.

ferris_built_light.text: Ferris built the light rig as a coded warning system to alert passing ships to danger.

mirror_guide_marks.text: Ferris scratched guide marks into the mirror frame for repairing the lamp.

true_lamp_lit.text: Mira set the mirror true and the tower's true lamp burns again.

signal_rig_can_call.text: The signal rig can flash a coded call across the water.

journal_found_on_chamber_desk.text: Mira found the keeper's journal resting on the desk in the keeper's room.

journal_has_signal_code.text: The keeper's journal records the coded signal pattern Mira studied.

drawer_split_desk_jammed.text: Wrenching split the drawer and jammed the desk; Mira gave up the search.

cavity_buried.text: Yanking the brick brought rubble down and buried the cavity for good.

rail_too_rotten.text: The gallery rail sagged; Mira retreated to the lamp room to wait for dawn.

waited_out_tide.text: The tide drove Mira back to a dry ledge to wait, safe but no closer to the answer.

backed_out_of_gap.text: Mira wriggled back out of the narrow gap and left it behind.

rung_snapped_fall.text: The cracked rung snapped and dropped Mira to the floor, unhurt.

hatch_buried_storm.text: Fallen gear buried the floor hatch and Mira walked home.

lantern_died_at_cellar.text: At the cellar door Mira's lantern died and she waited out the night.

step_crumbled_turned_back.text: The hollow step crumbled and Mira turned back down.

rope_frayed_turned_back.text: The rope frayed through and Mira climbed back up, the tunnel unreached.

fog_too_thick_ladder.text: The fog grew too thick and Mira climbed back to wait for it to lift.

wards_broken_door_jammed.text: Forcing the key broke the wards and jammed the keeper's door for good.

beam_near_miss.text: The beam shifted and pinned her coat; Mira backed out after a near miss.

gate_flooded_retreat.text: Water surged to her waist at the sea gate and Mira waded back.

bell_wire_dawn_patrol.text: A bell-wire chimed when Mira took the compass; a dawn patrol met her with hard questions and the evidence was spoiled.

gears_jammed_lamp_dark.text: Forcing the gears jammed the lamp mechanism for good; the tower stayed dark.

ferris_found_alive.text: Ferris is found alive at the shepherd's cottage.

search_party_found_ferris.text: A search party sent from the harbour office found Ferris safe and brought him home.

ferris_name_cleared.text: Ferris's good name is cleared and the real culprit is named.

mira_sought_shelter.text: Mira had only meant to find shelter from the fog.

mira_keeps_promise.text: Mira promises to mend the tower and tell the truth, and keeps her word.

smuggler_caught.text: The coastguard answers Mira's signal and the smuggler is caught among his hoard.

store_emptied_by_law.text: The harbour master, constable and revenue men empty the secret store.

hoard_case_sealed.text: Mira's untouched photographs seal the case against the smuggler.

coast_light_restored.text: The true beam sweeps the sea again and a fishing boat answers it.

rescue_signal_answered.text: Mira's coded call for help is answered by lights from the harbour and the sea.

signal_rig_documented.text: Mira writes down how the whole signal rig works, a solved mystery for the town.

letter_carried_unread.text: Mira carries the letter out still sealed and unread.

scheme_half_uncovered.text: Mira leaves the compass, photographs the hoard, and the smuggler's scheme stays half uncovered.

mystery_unsolved_for_now.text: Mira heads home with the mystery of the Hollow Lighthouse still unsolved for now.

journal_left_chalk_arrows.text: Mira leaves the journal on the desk as a signpost and chalks arrows along the tunnel.

journal_carried_home.text: Mira carries the keeper's journal home to hand to the town.

n_open.event: Having missed the last bus, Mira walks through fog toward the long-dark Hollow Lighthouse, where a pale light flickers in the lamp room.

n_start.event: Four ways open around the tower: cottage, tower stair, sea caves, boathouse.

a_office1.event: The keeper's cottage is cold and abandoned; Mira chooses between desk, shelves and hearth.

a_desk.event: The desk holds the keeper's log open to an unfinished last entry and a locked drawer.

a_desk_log.event: The log's last entry tells of a light Ferris never lit and footsteps drawing closer; the hall leads to the tower.

a_desk_drawer.event: Mira weighs picking the drawer lock with a letter-opener against wrenching it.

a_desk_pick.event: Picking the lock yields a brass key and a plan of the halls; Mira pockets the key.

a_shelf.event: The shelves hold bottled ships and logbooks; one bottle hides paper, one logbook is worn.

a_shelf_bottle.event: The bottled ship hides a sketch of a hidden door at the tower's foot.

a_shelf_books.event: The worn logbook holds sea-holly and a note: follow the hall when the light burns wrong.

a_hearth.event: Something square survives in the ash and a firebrick sits loose above it.

a_hearth_ash.event: The ash yields a scorched photo of Ferris beside a stranger on the gallery; Mira keeps it.

a_hearth_brick.event: Behind the jammed brick sits a cloth bundle; ease it out or yank the brick.

a_hearth_key.event: The bundle holds a brass key stamped with a tower mark she has seen sketched; she follows the hall.

a_corridor.event: The hall leads to the locked tower door, with a kitchen shortcut branching off.

a_kitchen.event: A sea-smelling draught behind the pantry leads Mira round to the tower door.

a_toward.event: The tower door stands ajar; the keeper's journal hangs on a hook beside it and Mira takes it.

b_lamp1.event: In the lamp room the light pulses without heat; lens, gallery and clockwork draw her eye.

b_lens.event: The lens is unlit; the glow comes through a cracked panel and a recently fitted hidden reflector.

b_lens_crack.event: Through the crack the light is seen rising up a shaft from below; a stair follows it down.

b_lens_reflect.event: The reflector bounces light up from below: a built trick, not a ghost; a stair leads down.

b_gallery.event: The gallery rail is rusted over a fog-hidden drop; step out or look through the window.

b_gallery_out.event: The rail trembles under her hand; trust it or step back.

b_gallery_fog.event: Through the window Mira sees the glow leaking from a grille at the tower's base.

b_clock.event: The rusted clockwork chain groans; wind it or follow the chain down.

b_clock_wind.event: Winding the mechanism drops open a floor section onto a stair down.

b_clock_chain.event: The chain drops down a shaft; Mira takes the maintenance stair beside it.

b_down.event: The way down splits into a spiral stair and a tight service hatch.

b_down_spiral.event: The spiral stair ends at a landing at the tower's foot where the keeper's journal lies on a stool.

b_down_hatch.event: The hatch drops Mira onto the same landing, where the keeper's journal waits on a stool.

c_cave1.event: The sea caves breathe with the tide; a wet passage, glimmering pools and a carved arch lead off.

c_pass.event: The passage narrows and the tide is rising; push on or hesitate.

c_pass_deep.event: Mira outpaces the water to a dry ledge with steps climbing toward the tower.

c_pool.event: The pools glow with weed the colour of the tower light, and metal gleams in one.

c_pool_glow.event: Mira realizes the glowing weed paints the ghost light; a rope handrail leads to a stair up.

c_pool_metal.event: Mira finds and pockets a lost brass tide-badge; a rock stair climbs toward the tower.

c_arch.event: The arch bears tally marks and a shorthand warning; beyond it is a narrow gap.

c_arch_marks.event: The tallies count unlogged nights the light burned; the shorthand points to a stair up away from the rising sea.

c_arch_gap.event: Stone presses on her chest in the gap; wriggle on or back out.

c_gather.event: The stair brings Mira under the tower, where worn steps and an iron ladder lead up.

c_steps.event: The worn steps reach a dry landing at the tower's base with the keeper's journal on a stool.

c_ladder.event: The ladder reaches the same landing, where the keeper's journal waits on its stool.

d_boat1.event: The leaning boathouse holds a tarped dinghy, a tool locker and a ladder to a loft.

d_dinghy.event: Under the tarp are oilskins and a rattling bailing tin.

d_dinghy_tarp.event: A chart shows a passage inked under the lighthouse, pointing to a floor hatch.

d_dinghy_tin.event: The tin holds a brass key and a note: the light is not a ghost, it is a signal.

d_locker.event: The locker holds rope and an oil lantern; Mira picks one.

d_locker_rope.event: With the rope over her shoulder, Mira finds a worn floor hatch.

d_locker_lantern.event: Mira lights the lantern and spots a worn floor hatch.

d_loft.event: The loft ladder is missing rungs and one is cracked; climb carefully or trust it.

d_loft_up.event: The loft holds signal flags and a flash-code diagram; a trapdoor drops her beside the floor hatch she noticed earlier.

d_hatch.event: The hatch is stiff and the door bangs in a rising storm; go down or turn to the door.

d_hatch_down.event: The passage under the rock reaches a landing at the tower's base with the keeper's journal on a stool.

n_journal.event: Every path reaches the keeper's journal: entries on the wrong light, a ledger of undeclared night cargoes, a tunnel sketch.

jr_light.event: Ferris's uneasy entries describe a light he could not explain; a description page and a column of dates stand out.

jr_light_read.event: Ferris wrote the light is made, not haunted, with its source below; take the hidden stair.

jr_light_date.event: The light's dates are foggy nights matching the cargo landings; a note points to a hidden stair.

jr_light_join.event: Mira presses the landing wall where the notes say and a hidden panel opens on a stair climbing upward.

jr_smug.event: The ledger lists night cargoes signed with an initial that is not the keeper's.

jr_smug_ledger.event: The figures never balance and one page is torn out.

jr_smug_copy.event: Mira copies the totals into her notebook as proof the tower was a private store; a note points to the hidden stair.

jr_smug_torn.event: The torn page, tucked in the back cover, names a hidden store and gives directions to the hidden stair.

jr_smug_names.event: The coded initials resolve to one smuggler who paid Ferris to look away, then wanted only the tower.

jr_smug_join.event: Turning toward the hidden stair, Mira notices a locked cellar door in the landing's corner.

jr_tunnel.event: The sketch shows a tunnel under a sea gate; a flagstone on the landing bears its cross.

jr_tun_sketch.event: The sketch marks the hidden stair as the only dry way down to the tunnel; Mira opens the panel it shows.

jr_tun_stone.event: The flagstone is stuck fast; heave it or trust the sketch's drier route.

jr_tun_join.event: The sketch wins out: the wall panel already stands open and Mira starts up the hidden stair.

n_stairs.event: All three journal threads lead to the hidden stair, which splits into a winding inner stair and outer fog steps.

st_wind.event: The winding stair is dark and close; one step near the top sounds hollow.

st_wind_up.event: Keeping to the wall, Mira reaches a warm, glowing frosted-glass door.

st_outer.event: A gust slams her against the tower on the outer steps; push on or wait.

st_outer_wait.event: Mira waits out the gust and climbs to the frosted-glass door.

st_outer_up.event: The outer steps deliver her, cold and breathless, to the glowing frosted-glass door.

n_light.event: Behind the door the ghost light is a shuttered lantern with mirrors and cave-weed: a made signal. Three ways lead down.

li_stair.event: Partway down the stone stair a cupboard holds the keeper's belongings.

li_stair_down.event: The stair winds past the lamp-rig's wiring to an undercroft and a tunnel mouth.

li_stair_cup.event: The cupboard holds a spare lens scored like the rig and the keeper's storm coat.

li_cup_lens.event: The spare lens's marks prove the light was built by hand; Mira takes it and goes down.

li_cup_coat.event: The coat pocket holds the keeper's note: gone but not lost.

li_shaft.event: The shaft offers iron staples or a frayed knotted rope.

li_shaft_down.event: The staples hold and Mira reaches the undercroft and the tunnel mouth.

li_shaft_rope.event: The rope creaks under her weight; trust it or pull back.

li_ladder.event: The outer ladder is slick and the fog blinding; climb down or judge it too thick.

li_ladder_down.event: Climbing blind, Mira reaches the tower's foot and a low tunnel opening.

n_tunnel.event: Every descent reaches a brick tunnel; Mira lights a lantern there and faces three branches: keeper's door, crate store, sea gate.

tn_keeper.event: The keeper's sealed oak door has an old key in its lock and a fallen beam blocks the passage behind.

tn_keep_door.event: The old key turns half way and catches on rust; coax it or shove it.

tn_keep_open.event: The mechanism clunks and the keeper's door swings open on the sealed room.

tn_keep_stuck.event: The key sticks fast; ease it back or force it and risk the wards.

tn_keep_beam.event: Lever the wedged beam clear or squeeze under it.

tn_store.event: The store is stacked with unmarked crates and a locked ledger box.

tn_store_crate.event: A crate holds contraband lamp oil and cloth: a smuggler's haul in a tower thought haunted.

tn_store_box.event: The ledger box lists uncustomed goods; Mira carries it on toward the keeper's room.

tn_store_join.event: A draft gutters the lantern she lit at the tunnel mouth; press on or trim the wick.

tn_store_relight.event: Mira trims the wick and follows the lit passage to the door she recognizes from the sketch.

tn_gate.event: The tide is climbing the sea gate's bars; open it or think twice.

tn_gate_open.event: Mira squeezes onto a ledge past the gate as the current pulls; go now or wait.

tn_gate_wait.event: Waiting out the surge, Mira climbs a dry passage toward the keeper's room.

n_chamber.event: In the keeper's room under the sea a sealed letter waits; the truth of Ferris, the smuggler and the false light is here, and Mira is tired.

cm_letter.event: The letter is addressed to whoever is brave enough to climb; read it or keep it sealed.

cm_letter_read.event: Ferris fled the smuggler and hid inland, leaving the light to draw someone; a map, a confession and a plea follow.

cm_letter_map.event: The map leads to a shepherd's cottage on the moor; go herself or tell the harbour office.

cm_letter_conf.event: The confession admits years of paid blind eyes and the smuggler wanting everything.

cm_letter_plea.event: The plea asks her to say he is sorry and to light the tower true again; Mira takes it up.

cm_letter_keep.event: Mira keeps the letter sealed and tucks it in her coat.

cm_smug.event: With the store's crates and ledger laid bare, Mira can photograph them on her phone or follow the goods deeper.

cm_smug_photo.event: Mira photographs the crates and ledger box; signal the coastguard or go to the harbour master.

cm_smug_follow.event: Deeper in lies the smuggler's private hoard, apart from the declared crates, with a jewelled compass on top.

cm_smug_hoard.event: Mira photographs the whole hoard without touching it.

cm_smug_token.event: Mira is torn between pocketing the compass and doing the right thing.

cm_light.event: Mira weighs relighting the true lamp against studying Ferris's coded warning system.

cm_light_relight.event: The lamp could burn again: set the mirror by Ferris's guide marks or force the gears.

cm_light_true.event: Set true by the marks, the lamp flares and its beam sweeps the sea for the first time in a year.

cm_light_study.event: The rig can flash a coded call; use it to call for help or log how it works.

cm_leave.event: Tired in the fog, Mira weighs going straight home against marking the route for others.

cm_leave_town.event: Mira fixes the room in her memory and starts the long walk to town.

cm_leave_mark.event: Mira considers leaving the journal on the desk where she found it as a signpost, or carrying it to town.

e_set_a_drawer.event: Wrenching splits the drawer and jams the desk; Mira leaves the cottage's secrets for another night.

e_set_a_brick.event: The yanked brick brings rubble down over the cavity; Mira waits out the night by the door.

e_set_b_rail.event: The rail sags; Mira retreats into the lamp room to wait for dawn.

e_set_c_tide.event: The tide drives Mira back to a dry ledge to wait, safe but unsolved.

e_set_c_stuck.event: Mira wriggles back out of the gap and leaves the far chamber's secret.

e_set_d_loft.event: The cracked rung snaps; Mira, unhurt, waits on the shore for morning.

e_set_d_storm.event: The slamming door brings gear down over the hatch; Mira walks home.

e_set_cellar.event: At the cellar door Mira's borrowed lantern dies and she waits out the night on the landing.

e_set_stair.event: The hollow step crumbles and Mira makes her way back down.

e_set_shaft.event: The rope frays through; Mira climbs back up, the tunnel unreached.

e_set_fog.event: Mira will not climb blind and waits by the tower for the fog to lift.

e_set_door.event: Forcing the key breaks the wards and seals the keeper's room for good.

e_set_beam.event: The beam shifts and pins her coat; Mira backs out after a near miss.

e_set_gate.event: Sea water surges to her waist at the gate and Mira wades back to wait.

e_set_token.event: Taking the compass trips a bell-wire; a dawn patrol meets her and the evidence is spoiled.

e_set_gears.event: Forced gears jam the lamp mechanism; the tower stays dark.

e_win_keeper_found.event: Mira follows the map to the shepherd's cottage and finds Ferris alive, thinner than his photograph.

e_win_keeper_word.event: Mira takes the letter and map to the harbour office; a search party finds Ferris and his name is cleared.

e_win_name_cleared.event: With the confession Mira tells the town the truth; the false light was a cry for help and Ferris's name is restored.

e_win_promise.event: Mira promises to mend the tower and tell the truth, and keeps her word in the weeks after.

e_win_smugglers.event: Mira flashes the code she studied in the keeper's journal; the coastguard answers and the smuggler is caught.

e_win_harbor.event: The harbour master acts on Mira's proof and the secret store is emptied.

e_win_hoard.event: Mira's untouched photographs of the hoard seal the case.

e_win_light_restored.event: From the gallery Mira watches the true beam sweep the sea and a fishing boat answer it.

e_win_rescue.event: Mira's coded call for help, sent on Ferris's warning rig, is answered from harbour and sea.

e_win_signal.event: Mira documents the rig in her notebook; the ghost light is a solved, hand-built toy.

e_neutral_letter.event: Mira carries the letter out unread at dawn, for the right people to open.

e_neutral_honest.event: Mira leaves the compass and photographs the hoard; nobody is caught but she goes home wiser.

e_neutral_town.event: Too tired to go on, Mira heads home with the mystery unsolved but no longer frightening.

e_neutral_evidence.event: Mira leaves the journal on the desk as she found it and chalks arrows for those who follow.

e_neutral_museum.event: Mira carries the keeper's journal home to hand to the town.
